- 1. AND gate:

```
CHIP And {
   IN a, b;
   OUT out;
   PARTS:
   Nand(a=a, b=b, out=nandOut);
   Nand(a=nandOut, b=nandOut, out=out);
}
```

- 1. Or gate:

```
CHIP Or {
   IN a, b;
   OUT out;
   PARTS:
   Nand(a=a, b=a, out=notA);
   Nand(a=b, b=b, out=notB);
   Nand(a=notA, b=notB, out=out);
}
```

1. LAB2:
   1. XOR gate:

```
CHIP Xor {
   IN a, b;
   OUT out;
   PARTS:
   Not(in=a, out=nota);
   Not(in=b, out=notb);
   And(a=a, b=notb, out=C);
   And(a=nota, b=b, out=D);
   Or(a=C, b=D, out=out);
}
```

![](data:image/png;base64,)

- 1. MUX gate:

```
CHIP Mux {
   IN a, b, sel;
   OUT out;
   PARTS:
   Not(in=sel, out=C);
   And(a=a, b=C, out=x);
   And(a=b, b=sel, out=y);
   Or(a=x, b=y, out=out);
}
```

![](data:image/png;base64,)

- 1. DMux gate:

```
CHIP DMux {
   IN in, sel;
   OUT a, b;
   PARTS:
   Not(in=sel, out=nsel);
   And(a=in, b=nsel, out=a);
   And(a=in, b=sel, out=b);
}
```

PROJECT 2 :

1. LAB1:
   1. HalfAdder:

```
CHIP HalfAdder {
   IN a, b;    // 1-bit inputs
   OUT sum,    // Right bit of a + b
       carry;  // Left bit of a + b
   PARTS:
   //// Replace this comment with your code.
   Xor(a=a, b=b, out=sum);
   And(a=a, b=b, out=carry);
}
```

![](data:image/png;base64,)

- 1. FullAdder:

```
CHIP FullAdder {
   IN a, b, c;  // 1-bit inputs
   OUT sum,     // Right bit of a + b + c
       carry;   // Left bit of a + b + c
   PARTS:
   //// Replace this comment with your code.
   HalfAdder(a=a, b=b, sum=s1, carry=c1);
   HalfAdder(a=s1, b=c, sum=sum, carry=c2);
   Or(a=c1, b=c2, out=carry);
}
```

- 1. Add16:

```
CHIP Add16 {
   IN a[16], b[16];
   OUT out[16];
   PARTS:
   HalfAdder(a=a[0], b=b[0], sum=out[0], carry=c0);

   FullAdder(a=a[2], b=b[2], c=c1, sum=out[2], carry=c2);
```

1. LAB5:
   1. ALU:

```
CHIP ALU {
   IN
       x[16], y[16],  // 16-bit inputs
       zx,nx,zy,ny,f,no;
   OUT
       out[16],zr,ng;
   PARTS:
   Mux16(a=x, b=false, sel=zx, out=x1);
   Not16(in=x1, out=nx1);
   Mux16(a=x1, b=nx1, sel=nx, out=x2);
   Mux16(a=y, b=false, sel=zy, out=y1);
   Not16(in=y1, out=ny1);
   Mux16(a=y1, b=ny1, sel=ny, out=y2);
   And16(a=x2, b=y2, out=fAnd);
   Add16(a=x2, b=y2, out=fAdd);
   Mux16(a=fAnd, b=fAdd, sel=f, out=fOut);
   Not16(in=fOut, out=nfOut);
   Mux16(a=fOut, b=nfOut, sel=no, out=out, out[0..7]=low8, out[8..15]=high8, out[15]=ng);
   Or8Way(in=low8, out=orLow);
   Or8Way(in=high8, out=orHigh);
   Or(a=orLow, b=orHigh, out=notZero);
   Not(in=notZero, out=zr);
}
```
